_doc: Free-spirited weekend picks ('오늘 {p}와(과) 뭐 할까?'), just for fun — they only decide where the day goes, with their own little reply. By where you live: KR (인생네컷, 치맥…), JP (불꽃놀이, 이자카야…), FR (센 강 피크닉, 불랑제리…), ANGLO (drive-in, farmers' market…) — other countries use ANGLO. apart = long distance (anywhere). {p} = partner; season = only then.

label.en: Fried chicken & beer by the river with {p}

r.en: (Perfect breeze. {p} gave you the drumstick.)

label.en: Go take a four-cut photo booth strip

r.ko: (머리띠를 다섯 개나 써 봤다. 결국 토끼 귀로.)
r.en: (You tried on five headbands. Bunny ears won.)

label.en: Make couple rings at a workshop

r.ko: (반지 안쪽에 날짜를 새겼다. 손이 좀 떨렸다.)
r.en: (You engraved today's date inside. Your hands shook a little.)

label.en: Duet at a coin karaoke booth

r.ko: (고음에서 둘 다 삑사리. 그래서 더 웃겼다.)
r.en: (You both cracked on the high note. Even funnier.)

r.ko: (탈출 실패. 힌트를 네 번 썼다. 그래도 팀워크는 최고.)
r.en: (Didn't escape. Four hints. Teamwork: still elite.)
(Loser does the dishes. {p} lost. Probably on purpose.)

label.en: Matching pajamas and a drama marathon

r.ko: (밤새 12화까지 봤다. 둘 다 같은 장면에서 울었다.)
r.en: (Twelve episodes overnight. You both cried at the same scene.)

r.ko: (삼각김밥까지 나눠 먹었다. 별거 아닌데 제일 좋았다.)
r.en: (You split a rice triangle too. Nothing special — the best part.)

r.ko: (해가 다 질 때까지 아무 말도 안 했다. 그래도 좋았다.)
r.en: (Neither of you spoke until the sun was gone. It was perfect.)

r.ko: (목적지 없이 달리다 처음 보는 바다에 도착했다.)
r.en: (No destination — you ended up at a sea you'd never seen.)
(Stamps today: three. Stomachs: about to burst.)
(The orange cat climbed into {p}'s lap. You were jealous.)

r.ko: (어릴 때 얘기를 하다가, 미래 얘기까지 했다.)
r.en: (Childhood stories turned into future plans.)

label.en: Cook something neither of you has tried

r.en: (Half burnt. {p} ate it all and called it delicious.)

label.en: A picnic under the cherry blossoms

r.en: (A petal landed in {p}'s hair. You left it there.)
(Your spoons kept clinking. On purpose.)

r.ko: (낙엽 밟는 소리가 좋다고 {p}이(가) 같은 길을 세 번 걸었다.)
r.en: ({p} liked the crunch so much you walked it three times.)

label.en: Warm your hands with fish-shaped pastries

r.en: (Ten-minute debate: red bean or custard.)
(Solo, but you hit all four poses.)

label.en: Zone out by a café window

r.ko: (한 시간 동안 구름만 봤다. 완벽한 하루.)
r.en: (An hour of watching clouds. A perfect day.)

label.en: Ride a bus to the last stop

r.en: (A new neighborhood, and a great soup place.)

r.ko: (바람이 머리를 다 헝클어 놨다. 기분은 정리됐다.)
r.en: (The wind messed up your hair and tidied your head.)
(Outside the blanket is dangerous.)

r.ko: (18번 곡을 다섯 번 불렀다. 목이 쉬었다.)
r.en: (Your signature song, five times. Voice: gone.)

label.en: Yukata and a summer fireworks festival with {p}

r.en: (Every burst, you looked at {p}'s profile instead.)

label.en: Hanami — a bento under the cherry blossoms

r.ko: (돗자리 자리 잡느라 아침 6시에 나왔다. 그럴 가치가 있었다.)
r.en: (You claimed a spot at 6 a.m. Worth it.)
(Ordered ten skewers. Finished all ten.)

r.ko: (눈이 두 배로 커졌다. 둘 다 못 알아볼 지경.)
r.en: (Eyes twice their size. You can barely recognize yourselves.)

r.ko: (신상 푸딩 세 개. 둘이 반씩 나눴다.)
r.en: (Three new puddings, split down the middle.)

r.ko: (나온 건 둘 다 같은 고양이. 운명인가.)
r.en: (You both got the same cat. Fate?)

label.en: A day trip to an onsen town

r.ko: (족욕을 하며 손을 잡았다. 발도 손도 따뜻했다.)
r.en: (Holding hands in the foot bath. Warm feet, warm hands.)

label.en: Build a plate tower at conveyor-belt sushi

r.en: (Twenty-three plates. The staff applauded.)
(Didn't know the lyrics. Nailed the feelings.)

r.ko: (빨간 잎을 하나 주워 {p} 수첩에 끼워 줬다.)
r.en: (You tucked a red leaf into {p}'s notebook.)
(You can't leave. The kotatsu curse.)

label.en: Coffee and a book at a kissaten

r.en: (The master refilled your water without a word.)
(Bought twelve things you don't need.)
(Drank every drop of broth. Day complete.)

label.en: A shrine walk and an omikuji

r.en: (Great blessing! Love: closer than you think.)

r.ko: (바게트, 치즈, 와인 한 병. 해가 질 때까지.)
r.en: (Baguette, cheese, a bottle of wine — until sunset.)
(You brushed the crumbs off each other.)

label.en: Treasure hunting at the flea market

r.ko: (낡은 엽서 한 장을 샀다. 100년 전 누군가의 연애편지.)
r.en: (You bought an old postcard — someone's love letter from a century ago.)
(You made up stories about passers-by and laughed.)
(You watched {p} looking at paintings longer than the paintings.)

label.en: Wine and dinner at a tiny bistro

r.en: (The chef sent dessert on the house. 'For the lovers.')

label.en: A game of pétanque in the park

r.en: (The local grandpas coached you both.)

r.ko: (길을 잃었다. 덕분에 더 예쁜 골목을 찾았다.)
r.en: (You got lost — and found a prettier street.)

label.en: The green chairs at the Luxembourg Gardens

r.ko: (의자 두 개를 붙여 놓고 햇볕을 쬐었다.)
r.en: (Two chairs pushed together, soaking up the sun.)

label.en: Vin chaud at the Christmas market

r.en: (You held the cup tight instead of a hand warmer.)

label.en: A café crème and a poetry book

r.en: (The waiter smiled: 'Bonne journée.')
(You loved the smell of old paper.)
(You tried counting the love locks. Gave up.)
(The popcorn war was fiercer than the movie.)

r.ko: (복숭아를 한 박스 샀다. 둘이 다 못 먹는다.)
r.en: (You bought a whole box of peaches. Way too many.)
(Burnt sausages. Still the best lunch.)

label.ko: 다이너에서 밀크셰이크 하나에 빨대 두 개
label.en: One milkshake, two straws at a diner

r.en: (You each saved the last sip for the other.)
(Five gutter balls. High-fives anyway.)
(You both yelled from the top.)
(You both reached for the same album.)
(You watched the city lights come on one by one.)
(Together, you were peanut butter and jelly.)

r.ko: (넘어질 때마다 서로를 붙잡았다. 둘 다 넘어졌다.)
r.en: (You caught each other every fall. You both fell.)
(The marshmallow caught fire. Tasted better that way.)
(Today's line: I'm okay.)

label.en: Watch dogs at the dog park

r.en: (A golden retriever brought you its ball.)

label.en: A solo thriller at the cinema

r.en: (Spilled all the popcorn.)

label.en: Press play on the same movie as {p}

r.en: (3, 2, 1… play. Same 'whoa' at the same scene.)

label.en: Study together on a video call

r.ko: (아무 말 안 해도 화면 너머 숨소리가 좋았다.)
r.en: (No talking needed. Hearing them breathe was enough.)
(Three pages. The last line: 'I miss you.')

label.en: A morning call across the time difference

r.en: (Your night became {p}'s morning.)
